spans.s: शिञ्ज्, ii. 2, Ātm. To tinkle, Bhaṭṭ. 14, 4;

(Par.).
 --Ptcple. of the pf. pass. शिञ्जित, Tinkling,
; of metallic ornaments worn as chains, rings, etc., Vikr. d. 93.

शिञ्ज् + अ,
 I. m. Tinkling.
 II. f. जा, A bow-string.

शिञ्ज् + इन्,
 I. adj. Tinkling.
 II. f. नी.
 1. A bow-string.
 2. Metallic rings worn round the toes.
